{"evidence":[{"sentence_id":0,"text":"The 2010 Aegon Championships (also known traditionally as the \"Queen's Club Championships\") was a tennis tournament played on outdoor grass courts.","title":"2010 Aegon Championships"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" It was the 39th edition of the Aegon Championships and was part of the ATP World Tour 250 series of the 2010 ATP World Tour.","title":"2010 Aegon Championships"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" It took place at the Queen's Club in London, United Kingdom, from 7 to 13 June 2010.","title":"2010 Aegon Championships"},{"sentence_id":3,"text":" The field was headlined by the 2008 champion and current world number one Rafael Nadal, Novak Djokovic, Andy Roddick and defending champion Andy Murray.","title":"2010 Aegon Championships"},{"sentence_id":0,"text":"Brooklyn Danielle Decker Roddick (born April 12, 1987) is an American fashion model and actress best known for her appearances in the \"Sports Illustrated Swimsuit Issue\", including the cover of the 2010 issue.","title":"Brooklyn Decker"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" In addition to working for Victoria's Secret for the 2010 \"Swim\" collection, she has ventured into television with guest appearances on \"Chuck\", \"Ugly Betty\", \"The League\", and \"Royal Pains\".","title":"Brooklyn Decker"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" She made her feature film debut in \"Just Go with It\", and later starred in \"Battleship\" and \"What to Expect When You're Expecting\".","title":"Brooklyn Decker"},{"sentence_id":3,"text":" Decker is married to former tennis player Andy Roddick.","title":"Brooklyn Decker"}],"peer_messages":[],"previous_answer":null,"question":"Who was born first, Brooklyn Decker or Andy Roddick?"}
